_readme: S741 lane 1 (keys): San Bernardino Valley College's four held records whose own page no free read has printed yet, each read as the capture reads the page (capture_view), free, no model call, nothing written: Geographic Information Systems certificate 35833 (its 19-22 sits inside the printed 18.5-22: which unit figure does the page print beside GIS 098?), Music A.A. 04894 (the applied pair 'MUS 141X2 & MUS 241X2' and its one figure), Environmental Science A.S. 17829 (the printed 50-63 against lists that add to 50-60) and Automotive Wheel Alignment and Brakes certificate 22784 (the placement waiver over TECALC 087 and 'Total Units 16-20').
